page.title: Images
page.description: Manage GPUWorks runtime images by series, version, and node distribution

catalog.hint: System images are maintained by GPUWorks. Check for updates from the GPUWorks manifest site, or upload a manifest JSON file when this server is offline.

summary.catalogSizeHelp: Sum of declared archive sizes for image versions in the current source. Unknown sizes are excluded; “—” means all sizes are unknown. Archive size is not actual node disk usage.
summary.localSizeHelp: Sum of the most recently reported image-copy sizes across nodes. Shared layers are counted for each image, so this is not deduplicated disk usage. Unknown sizes are excluded.

action.removeFailed: The image could not be deleted
action.cancelFailed: The transfer could not be cancelled.

seriesTable.deleteDescription: All versions and node distribution records in this series will also be deleted.

versionTable.sizeHelp: Estimated compressed Registry layer size. Actual node usage is reported by each node.
versionTable.deleteDescription: Node distribution records for this version will also be deleted.
versionTable.deprecatedSince: Superseded in catalog {{version}}; kept only for the deployments still using it and the nodes that pulled it

localDialog.title: Import a local file on {{node}}
localDialog.description: Load the archive as {{ref}}. This updates the image on this node without creating an image series.
localDialog.help: Enter the absolute path of an existing tar file on this compute node, not a directory or a management server path. The node runtime must support its format. The original file is kept.

nodeTable.inspectHelp: Read the image's own entrypoint, environment, and volume declarations from the node; shown read-only, not stored
nodeTable.autoNote: Where an image is pulled from is decided automatically by the Pull Settings.
nodeTable.removeImpact: Only this node's local copy will be removed. The catalog version and copies on other nodes will remain.
nodeTable.sourceUnknownHelp: The image is on the node, but the platform has no record of where it came from: a replica pulled it when it started, or someone pulled it on the node by hand.
nodeTable.relayHelp: The management server downloads the archive and streams it to this node. Use it when the node cannot reach the mirror itself; the transfer cannot resume.

peerDialog.title: Sync {{ref}} to {{node}} from another node
peerDialog.description: The chosen source sends the image directly when possible. If direct connection fails and both nodes permit storage sync over the management network, the management server can relay the transfer.
peerDialog.sourcePlaceholder: Choose a node that already has this image
peerDialog.rateHelp: Applies to this transfer only. Leave empty or 0 for no additional limit. Relay remains subject to platform limits.
peerDialog.probeHint: Test the transfer connection before starting.
peerDialog.probeRelay: Connection verified via the management server relay.
peerDialog.probeFailed: The source cannot establish a transfer connection to this node

archiveDialog.title: Get {{ref}} on {{node}} from a URL
archiveDialog.description: Paste the address of a docker save archive. Resolve it first: the references are read out of the archive itself, not guessed from the file name.
archiveDialog.recordNote: This address will be recorded in {{ref}}'s acquisition addresses, so other nodes and deployments can use it too.
archiveDialog.mismatch: This archive carries a different image, so the transfer was refused
archiveDialog.mismatchDetail: {{ref}} is the image being fetched, but the archive contains {{tags}}. Check that you pasted the right archive.
archiveDialog.unverified: This archive could not be checked before the download

nodeTable.repullHelp: Pull this rolling tag again on this node so it gets whatever the tag points at upstream now.

import.customNotice: Image registries are resolved by platform rules
import.customDescription: When a node pulls the image, it tries the addresses the image declares together with the pull source rules (Settings → Pull settings), and finally the actual registry. Community and custom images are not restricted by repository name.
import.seriesNamePlaceholder: Leave blank to group automatically by the image repository
import.tagRequired: Enter an image reference with a tag; digests are not supported in this release
import.registrySourcesHelp: Extra addresses this image can be fetched from: registry references, or the URL of a docker save archive.

url.title: Import from a URL
url.description: Paste the address of a docker save archive. Its real image references are read out of the archive itself, so you do not have to guess them from the file name.
url.label: Image archive URL
url.required: Enter the image archive URL first.
url.failed: The image archive could not be read.
url.allowAuto: Automatically add {{host}} to the allow list
url.allowFailed: This address could not be allowed.
url.tagsUnknown: The references could not be read from this archive.
url.notPreviewable: This archive cannot be inspected before it is downloaded. Enter the image reference yourself; the node tags whatever the archive turns out to carry.
url.matched: {{ref}} is already in the catalog. The URL was added to it.
url.prefilled: The form below was filled in with {{ref}}. Complete the remaining fields and add the image.

import.frameworkRequired: Select a framework; images without one are never recommended automatically
import.rollingTagHelp: Tags such as nightly or latest move upstream; nodes can pull them again later.

community.title: Community repositories
community.reposFailed: The community repository list could not be loaded
community.accessUnknown: The access host for this repository is unavailable. Review the outbound access policy.
community.tagsFailed: The tags of {{repo}} could not be listed
community.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, for example qwen38 or nightly
community.noTags: This repository has no tags upstream

import.enginesFailed: The inference engine list could not be loaded

detail.title: {{name}} · Details
detail.builtInFrom: Read from {{node}} just now; shown as read, not stored.
detail.builtInHint: Inspect the image on a node that holds it to see the ENTRYPOINT, CMD, ENV and VOLUME it was built with. Deployments do not inherit catalog settings; choose the image entrypoint command mode when deploying to run this entrypoint.
detail.selectVersion: Select a version to view node distribution, sources, and pull/distribution actions
detail.digestMismatch: {{ref}}: the image IDs on {{nodes}} nodes differ
detail.versionHint: Click a version to see where it is on each node, its sources, and pull or distribution actions.
